items.docs: Returns the readiness status of the APIcast gateway. Used as a Kubernetes readiness probe. Returns 200 when the gateway is ready to accept traffic, non-200 when not ready.
Returns the liveness status of the APIcast gateway. Used as a Kubernetes liveness probe. Returns 200 if the process is alive.
Returns internal information about the APIcast gateway including timer states, worker process counts, and internal configuration parameters useful for debugging.
